cues: Rigid numbered-section template (Summary, Context and Goals, Drivers/Requirements/Constraints, Current State, Assumptions and Open Questions, Key Decisions, Build Sequence, Deferred Work, Next Steps) that reads like a prescribed planning methodology
Explicit assumption-ID system ([A1]–[A11]) with impact-if-wrong and validation-date columns, and open questions each carrying a default and a needed-by date
Ranked quality attributes with measurable targets, and a decision log (D1–D10) listing options considered, rationale against drivers, reversibility and revisit triggers
Milestones with risk cleared, exit criteria, dependencies and sizes, plus time-boxed spikes that state 'changes the plan if' conditions
Opens with a note on finding an empty workspace and choosing defaults instead of asking questions, then ends with the questions that would change the plan most
Dedicated sections for deferred work, rollback and testing strategy, and a critical-path statement, which go beyond an ordinary unstructured plan
